verdict.rationale: Codex works within git-based repos, letting users inspect diffs, run reviews against commits/branches, and open PRs (codex-docs-5, codex-docs-10), which implicitly supports version-review-rollback style workflows via standard git tooling. However there's no explicit feature for versioning or rolling back 'automations' (e.g. skills/workflows) themselves — 'package repeatable instructions as skills' (codex-docs-20) has no documented versioning or rollback mechanism. Missing for 10: dedicated automation/skill versioning system, explicit rollback command for automations, independent evidence of this workflow in practice.
